title: Review-share reduction: abstain-band half-width sweep + LOCO calibration on IndEgo gold (target <60%)
why: E8.01 leaves 75.5% of 1,546 Egocentric-10K windows in REVIEW; the PoC needs review <60% without faking accuracy.
hypothesis: Narrowing the symmetric abstain band cuts review at a measurable in-domain error cost; monotone calibration may re-centre the band but cannot reorder the review/error frontier.
data: E8.01 1,546 unlabelled Egocentric-10K windows (label_source none); 150-window IndEgo human gold (LOCO); 60-window human-labelled Egocentric-10K (51/9) as pre-registered OOD test only
method: symmetric band half-width w in 0..0.30; temperature/Platt/isotonic fit LOCO on gold only; balanced accuracy on decided windows; clip/window bootstrap CIs; LOCO-vs-in-sample calibration consistency check

summary: Raw symmetric band w=0.16 -> review 53.4% (from 75.5%) at IndEgo gold BA 0.846 (err 0.154, 95% CI 0.662-0.931); exact widest band <60% is w=0.177 (59.6%, err 0.150); w=0.12 gives 37.0% at err 0.153. Calibration does NOT cut review at equal error: in-sample temperature is neutral vs raw (31.6% vs 32.0% min review at gold err<=0.155); the LOCO temperature 'gain' (9.4%) is a per-fold small-sample artifact; Platt/isotonic degrade gold BA to 0.71/0.725. OOD-60 decisions stay 0.34-0.53 BA (near chance, n_bad=9) -> unreliable.
decision: Ship raw band half-width 0.16 (band [0.34,0.66]) on the frozen score; no calibration; keep OOD near-chance caveat in the verdict.
